_about: The two compact captures made in a real browser session on 2026-10-21, exactly as the page hashed them, and the key map that assembled proposals/DATA-LOCALITY-ABUNDANCE-2026-10-21.json from them. Capture keys are the capture-time names (scenario-flavoured, e.g. porphyry_bingham); some captured keys were not used by any data locality. Listing titles themselves were classified inside the page and were not saved. tools/locality-abundance-compare.mjs recomputes both hashes and checks every data-file count against these captures before it compares anything.
